name: Dr. Kyungmin Lee
affiliation: Assistant Professor, Department of Environmental Studies and Sciences; Sustainability Director, Office of Sustainability, Adelphi University
interests: Energy and environmental policy, sustainability analytics, artificial intelligence, satellite and thermal imagery, and computational social science
bio: Dr. Kyungmin Lee is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Environmental Studies and Sciences and Sustainability Director at Adelphi University.

Her research examines energy and environmental policy, climate policy, urban sustainability, sustainability analytics, and community development. She integrates qualitative and quantitative methods with artificial intelligence, computational social science, and satellite and thermal imagery.
Her current projects investigate urban heat and cooling infrastructure, the environmental impacts of data centers, thermal imaging of energy systems, and evidence-based campus sustainability.

name: Linda Beneventano
affiliation: M.S. Student in Environmental Studies, Adelphi University
interests: Environmental policy, sustainability, environmental impacts of data centers, urban heat, and interdisciplinary environmental analysis
bio: Linda Beneventano is a master's student in Environmental Studies at Adelphi University and a graduate researcher in the SAGE Lab.
Her research interests include sustainability, and the environmental impacts of data centers.
Her work combines environmental studies with sensing,data analysis, and interdisciplinary sustainability research.
